item.title: Trump's Historic China Summit, Lindsay Clancy Retrial, Bomb Found at Ethanol Plant: AM Update 11/17 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
President Trump travels to Asia for a historic summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin, where nuclear disarmament, international security, and trade are expected to dominate discussions. Lindsay Clancy faces a retrial in March after jurors deadlocked over her insanity defense in the deaths of her three children - co-host of The MK True Crime Show Dave Aronberg weighs in. Federal authorities investigate an alleged bomb discovered at a Peoria, Illinois ethanol plant after a sweeping evacuation and conflicting reports about whether a suspect is in custody. Robert Pattinson is selected as the next James Bond following a competitive casting process, securing a three-film deal as Amazon prepares to relaunch the franchise.
